'''Cliff''' (Japanese: '''クリフ''' ''Cliff'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW046|The Beartic Mountain Feud!]]''. He works for the Mountain Patrol.

Cliff showed up to protect {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} from a group of {{p|Beartic}} and later brought them back to his home in order to take a break. Cliff was impressed with {{MTR}}'s Pokémon translation abilities and attempted to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} him, but was unsuccessful.

Cliff explained to the group that the area has two Beartic populations, one at the foot of the mountain and the other at its summit. He guided the group through the forest to try to return the rescued {{p|Cubchoo}} to its family. His {{p|Mienfoo}} proved invaluable to the task, helping Cliff and the group to locate {{AP|Pikachu}}, {{AP|Oshawott}}, {{AP|Tepig}}, {{TP|Iris|Axew}}, Meowth, and Cubchoo after they became separated.

After sending Ash and his friends on their way, he decided to help the base mountain Beartic find a new [[berry]] foraging area to avoid future conflict.
